v: Calgary's building permit value is up this year. But not because of homes.
From January to September, permit applications listed six point four billion dollars in estimated construction value. Up about ten per cent on the same months last year.
Residential applications? Down about five hundred and fifty million dollars.
Non-residential, like commercial and industrial, rose about one point one billion. Up about eighty per cent.
